run_visualcloze_generation: run the VisualClozeGenerationPipeline to generate images from visual in-context examples and text prompts
encode_visualcloze_prompt: encode layout, task, and content prompts into T5 and CLIP text embeddings with LoRA scaling support
prepare_visualcloze_latents: prepare image and mask latents by encoding through VAE, packing into patches, and adding noise for denoising
unpack_visualcloze_latents: unpack packed latent patches back into per-image tensors with correct dimensions for VAE decoding
validate_visualcloze_inputs: validate task_prompt, content_prompt, image structure, and embedding consistency before pipeline execution
